internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Due to Dependency Unreachable
internal.body:
At 11:47 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for the cart service due to a high error rate (0.1). Diagnosis identified the root cause as a dependency unreachable issue related to the Valkey connection. The issue was confirmed by logs and metrics. A mitigation action was proposed and approved to disable the cartFailure flag, which was executed at 12:07 UTC. Post-action monitoring verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels (0.002). The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 11:47 UTC: Alert received for cart service error rate spike.
- 12:07 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed dependency unreachable fault.
- 12:07 UTC: Mitigation action proposed and approved.
- 12:07 UTC: Action executed and recovery verified.

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.
